subject: Operator role boundaries & witnessing sprint for private deployment addendum
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@clinicalcore.com>
To: irene_choi@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@clinicalcore.com>
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Operator role boundaries & witnessing sprint for private deployment addendum

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As we get into legal review of the MSA addendum and order form for the VPC/on-prem deployment, we put together a set of redlines focused on operator role boundaries and the witnessing steps we need for auditability. Attached: ClinicalCore_MSARedlines_20260502.docx (redline).

Top asks from our side:
- Confirm that "operator" access is limited to runtime execution (no distribution or derivative rights).
- Confirm the process and timeline for a witnessed forensic snapshot and who can attend (auditor + technical witness).
- Provide a short ops checklist showing how temporary console / session access will be scoped and revoked.

Can you propose a short schedule for the witnessing sprint (we prefer something in the 2-week window starting 5/11) and confirm who from Redwood will be the technical lead and legal contact? Also please confirm any artifacts you will provide (snapshots, logs, step-by-step checklist).

Thanks,
Elena

--
Elena Rossi
Head of Security Programs
ClinicalCore Health
elena.rossi@clinicalcore.com
+1 415-555-0189
(Attachment: ClinicalCore_MSARedlines_20260502.docx)

From: irene_choi@redwoodinference.com
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@clinicalcore.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Operator role boundaries & witnessing sprint for private deployment addendum

Elena —

Appreciate the clear asks and the redlines. Quick answers up front:
- License scope: Redwood is prepared to confirm operator rights are limited to runtime execution only; we will not grant distribution or derivative rights in the addendum language.
- Witnessing: we can run a witnessed forensic snapshot with a named auditor + up to two client technical attendees. We will provide the snapshot file, checksums, and a runbook of steps used to create it.
- Console/session access: we can create time-limited, IP-restricted read-only accounts and ephemeral session tokens; all sessions will be audited and logs retained for the period in the order form.

Proposed sprint: 2026-05-11 through 2026-05-22.
- Tech lead: Marissa Cole (marissa_cole) — operational runbook and snapshot owner.
- Legal contact: Laura Bennett (laura_bennett) — will review and sign the narrow addendum changes.

I've uploaded our initial checklist and an SLA matrix to a shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeFG. Also attaching the internal operator roles matrix for your review (OperatorBoundaries_SLA_matrix.xlsx).

Next steps:
1) Confirm the sprint dates and which day you prefer for the live witness.
2) Laura will propose the exact redline language for the license paragraph we referenced.
3) If that looks good, we can circulate a short DocuSign envelope for the addendum.

I'll leave the legal detail to Laura — looping her in below.

Thanks,
Irene

--
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Counsel
Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwoodinference.com
(Attachment: OperatorBoundaries_SLA_matrix.xlsx)

From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@clinicalcore.com>
To: irene_choi@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@clinicalcore.com>, Tom Baker <tbaker@clinicalcore.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Operator role boundaries & witnessing sprint for private deployment addendum

Irene / team —

Thanks for the quick response and proposed sprint. A couple of items legal needs clarity on before we can lock dates:
1) The license redline needs an explicit sentence stating "Operator access is limited to execution within the licensed environment; no copy, export, or sublicense rights to runtime artifacts are granted." Can Redwood confirm it will accept that wording or propose a close alternative?
2) For the forensic snapshot: will Redwood provide a sealed snapshot and a notarized checksum, or only a snapshot with signed manifest? We need chain-of-custody language for our auditors.
3) Please confirm the maximum retention window for session logs (we requested 12 months in our redlines).

Attaching our markups to your matrix. Can Laura call out exact paragraph numbers for the edits so our counsel can align DocuSign exhibits?

Alex Mercer
Sr. Counsel, Contracts
ClinicalCore Health
alex.mercer@clinicalcore.com
(Attachment: ClinicalCore_MSARedlines_20260502_marked.pdf)

From: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@clinicalcore.com>, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@clinicalcore.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 11:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Operator role boundaries & witnessing sprint for private deployment addendum

Alex / Elena —

Thank you — we reviewed your markups. Laura here; a couple of clarifying points and proposed language:

1) License sentence: we can accept the core concept. Proposed phrasing for insertion into MSA Addendum, Section 3.2: "Operator rights are strictly limited to execution of the licensed runtime within the agreed deployment environment. No right is granted to copy, export, distribute, or create derivative works of the runtime or model artifacts outside of the licensed environment." Please confirm if that tracks with your counsel.

2) Snapshot & chain-of-custody: Redwood will provide a sealed forensic snapshot with a signed manifest and SHA256 checksums. We are not a third-party notary; if you require notarization we can coordinate a mutually-agreed neutral witness (we can host the snapshot transmission and provide timestamped logs). Proposed clause edits are attached (redline).

3) Session log retention: we can commit to 12 months retention for session logs tied to the evidence package; we will also include per-token cost and latency breakdowns in the witness report if useful.

Operational constraints: the witnessed snapshot will require a narrow window (3–4 hours) with pre-agreed test steps. We will not provide admin/root credentials; we will provide access via a read-only auditor account plus an exported snapshot file.

If this is acceptable we will prepare a short addendum and a DocuSign envelope for signatures. Suggest scheduling the live witness on one of these options: 2026-05-12 AM (preferred) or 2026-05-14 AM.

Laura Bennett
Head of Legal — Contracts
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
(Attachment: MSA_Addendum_redline_20260504.docx)

From: irene_choi@redwoodinference.com
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@clinicalcore.com>, Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@clinicalcore.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Operator role boundaries & witnessing sprint for private deployment addendum

Elena / Alex —

Operational checklist for the witness session (high level):
1) Pre-sprint: exchange signed NDA + addendum via DocuSign.
2) Day-of:
   - Marissa will provision an auditor read-only account and a time-limited console token.
   - We will run the snapshot creation steps while on a screenshare; auditors may observe and capture checksums.
   - We will transmit the snapshot via SFTP to your secured storage and provide a signed manifest (SHA256).
3) Post-session: we will provide the runbook used, retention schedule for logs (12 months), and a short witness report (including latency/cost metadata requested).

Two logistics asks from our side:
- Please confirm preferred time slot on 5/12 AM (PST) or 5/14 AM (PST).
- Confirm the two named ClinicalCore attendees (auditor + tech) and an address/email for the SFTP endpoint.

Marissa — please prepare the runbook and token provisioning plan and share by EOD tomorrow. Karthik — can you confirm whether this sprint changes the order form billing (we may need a small professional services SKU)?

Thanks,
Irene

(Attachment: Witnessing_Checklist_v1.txt)
